Station Souvenir Hints

  • Stars: 4
  • It is mandatory to turn on all particles before getting this Station Souvenir.
  • Take note of the four hints at the Concourse of this station. They are denoted in the increasing order.
  • Find in ascending order the number of bricks that have water dropping from it in each Exit Passageway. Then, click the buttons corresponding to that Exit Passageway.
  • Access the Station Souvenir through an entering from the West Outer Ring Elevator.
  • The Station Souvenir comes in the form of a potion.

Station Gauntlet

  • The theme and challenge modes of this Station Gauntlet are as follows:
  • Solo
  • Notes
  • Water

Hints

  • Stars: 2
  • Make use of the floor signs beneath the glass to find the corresponding button set from each platform.
  • One of the groups require you to answer the number of the cave from which water flows out, and another group requires you to count the number of caves from which water flows. A third group requires you to choose the wool that does not fit the hints.
  • Check the direction of floor water flow in one of the hints to check if you have missed anything.
  • The Station Gauntlet Souvenir comes in the form of a water bottle.

Fun Facts

  • This station is the first Island Station ever built. They are characterised by large platform passageways behind the platforms, as well as the irregularity of the passageways. However, the narrow platforms and platform passageways of Island Stations stem from the design of the Underground Stations in Terracept Division.https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=G1G4tPbraYo&t=415s</ref>
  • This Station is the first station to undergo expansion in 2018.

Fun Facts

  • While the original name of this station was '''Empyrean Station''', as this station was at a considerable distance away from the Nagasora development area, the new name of this station is taken from a nearby street of the same name. However, it should also be noted that, on March 2022, built Nagasora Station at the actual development area in Nagasora.
  • The name of this station refers to a sword of the Same Name that is used by the Frankish Military Leader Roland in the Matter of France Stories. However, the Chinese Name of this station is a re-translation from the Typical Chinese Name.
  • The blocks of gold in this station is an answer to the blocks of diamond used in Blu Trove Bay Station and the blocks of gold which also appeared in Centopia. Moreover, the blocks of gold also took reference from the sword at the nearby park.https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=pm-vCwvEA-0&t=3739s</ref>
  • Centopia (District), or the future Nazca Railway Headquarters, is located three kilometers directly to the north of this station on a pill-shaped artificial island. Due to the longer distance travelled, trains also accelerate when leaving this station from the north.
  • The bridge support pillars to the north of this station contains blocks of diamond and blocks of quartz, an indicator that the trains are approaching or leaving Centopia from its south. However, the bridge support pillars to the south of Platform 3 (Centopia Depot) are normal bridge pillars.
  • As the Bus Station outside Exit A already existed before the existance of this station, Exit A is adjusted to the same width as the Bus Station.

History

  • July 12 2020: This station began services.

Facilities

  • North Zone:
  • Earnock Estate: A mid-sized public housing estate designed to house at least 1'100 residents.
  • Earnock Place: The shopping mall for Earnock Estate.

'''East Point Bay''' is one of the Sub-Districts of Asylum. It is located at the North of the East Coast of Asylum, and its District Code is 29-16.

History

East Point Bay is the Peninsula of the East Coast of Asylum, and is named East Point Bay because the shape of the bay is shaped like a Cape. To avoid confusion with Winter Point, the Developer of Asylum does not want the station which will be built in this area to use the same name.

Since the first inception of Asylum Development, East Point Bay has been planned to pay homage to the vicinity of the Ma On Shan Promenade. Due to its close proximity with the coast, this district features more Private Housing, which are arranged in the form of stairs and has lower density than more inland areas, with the heights of the buildings descending closer to the coast.

is Line Number 2 of NR Los Sengas Division, and is also a circular line at the east of Los Sengas. This line commenced services on May 25 2015 and formed a complete loop on September 28 2017. With 62 stations along the line, this circular line is longer than the other two circular lines ( and ). Moreover, a branch between and is set up on this branch, which commenced services on June 5 2020.

Description

is a circular line in NR Los Sengas Division, and passes through Downtown, Vector Bay, Oasis, Punctual, Cometsilk, Torrent, Abunest, Yowah, the Egress Continent, the Ingress Sea, Ingress, Glacier, Youngsters District and Sava, before returning to Metropolis Terminal through northeast Three High.

This route is represented by Orange on the Nazca Railway Route Map, and is Line Number 2.

Currently, this route is 97.285 km long, with a total of 62 stations.

Route Establishment (Birth of )

While first appeared alongside Metropolis Terminal on March 15 2015, and appeared once again in High Mesa Station due to the establishment of on May 24 that year, the route was not connected until May 25, and the first section to commnece services was between High Mesa Station and Kaling Channel Station. At the time, this line was only a short straight line in the urban area and its length was only two-thirds that of .

First Extension after years

After a year, the expansion of Thick River Station was finally complete, and with the establishment of the south section of , could finally extend, first to Youngsters' Spit Station to the north, and then to Lower Oasis Station, signifying the extension of this line to the rural area. Subsequent development in the Ingress Continent meant that this line extended to Circle Pit Station as well, bringing development to and in the process. Later, establishment of the and development in the Oasis area also meant this could extend to Backcomma Beach Station.

Hiatus

As saw continous development upon starting its extension works for 4 consecutive episodes (S2E7 - S2E10), Nazca Railway has decided to pause development of for a month in S2E11 and develop , , and instead, as well as merging the existing section with . As a result, did not develop until S2E12.

Works Continue

After a month of hiatus, continued its journey towards completion. In chronological order, the Ingress Sea area, Punctual area an Egress Continent, with , and being established or extended respectively in the process. Meanwhile, was also established in the WMA area. At that time, ring completion was but a step away (Route at the time: Hourglass Bay Station - Yowah North Station)

Ring Completion

After two years of continuous effort, has finally formed a complete loop, with Hourglass Bay Station and Yowah North Station finally being connected, and with Virtel Heights Station being built as a reserved interchange for and . Upon Ring Completion, Xylog Gate Station commenced services.

formed a complete loop on September 28 2017, and the " Completion Ceremony" was held in Outcave Station on October 1 that same year to commemorate this event.

Subsequent Development

On S3E11, inserted a branch between and , which passes through Torrent and Egress Continent. The branch commenced services on June 5 2020, with being built as a reserved interchange for , , and in the future.
